senses.gloss:
मीव् 1. मीव्, cl. 1. P. मीवति, मीवितुम्,
to move.

मीव् 2. मीव् (connected with rt. पीव्),
cl. 1. P. मीवति, मीवितुम्, to grow fat,
to be large or corpulent.

मीवग मीवग, (with Buddhists) a parti-
cular high number.

मीवर मीवर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. 1. मी),
hurting, killing, hurtful, injurious, mischievous; vene-
rable, worthy of esteem; (अस्), m. a general, leader
of an army.

मीवा मीवा, f. (probably fr. 2. मी; said to
be fr. 1. मी), the tape-worm, a worm generated in
the intestines, Ascarides; air, wind, (in this sense
also, according to some, मीवन्, आ, m.); = शीकर (?);
= सार (?).
